messages.subject: Additional legend
parts:
Dear ggplot2 users,

I want to add a legend when there is already one legend in a plot.

library(ggplot2)
mtcars$carb <- factor(mtcars$carb)
qplot(wt, mpg, data = mtcars, colour = carb) +
  geom_line(aes(group = carb, linetype = carb)) +
  geom_point(data= mtcars[mtcars$am==1,],
             colour="red", shape=17, size=5)

How to add a legend corresponding to the geom_point commend?
(Add a legend: am=1 with a filled triangle)

Thank you,
Soyeon
